title: The bounds, the stall remedies, the autopilot selfcheck and the autopilot answer path are removed
goal: After the runner is gone: delete _tools/bl_bounds.py and its tests and the backlog.py bounds command (and its place in bl_cli and bl_check); keep the read-only backlog.py stalled listing of claimed items with no work commit but drop its remedy ladder, its recorded autopilot decisions and its --took path from bl_stall.py; keep selfcheck's generic host checks (claims, checkout, memory) and drop the autopilot ones; remove AUTOPILOT_REFUSED and the --by autopilot answer path from bl_authority.py, backlog.py answer and kbdecide.py (the gate classes and the rule that only the operator answers a gate stay); keep kbdecide ratify/revert/digest for operator decisions. Planted tests for what stays; removed test ids go to test_ids_dropped.txt with the reason 'autopilot retired'. Interactive session; bl_authority.py and kbdecide.py are agents-rule files.
notes: Still present: bl_bounds.py; bl_stall ladder and --took; bl_selfcheck host-runners; bl_authority AUTOPILOT, AUTOPILOT_REFUSED, autopilot_may_answer, REVIEW_DAYS and --by autopilot; kbdecide --by autopilot (keep ratify, revert, digest, gate classes and 'only the operator answers a gate'). Tests naming it: test_backlog_authority.py 60, test_kbdecide.py 53, test_bl_authority_trust.py 32, test_backlog_headless_operator.py 19, test_bl_bounds.py 11, test_backlog_research.py 11. bl_authority.py and kbdecide.py are agents-rule files. Also still present: kbusage.py rot metrics reading _cache/autopilot, bl_land.py prune_runner_cache and clean_runner_leftovers, bl_base live_runners and MAX_RUNNERS: remove or file a bug each if outside touches. Traps: tests copy fixed tool lists into temp repos and break when a module goes (TOOL_FILES in test_backlog_research.py, KS_TOOLS in test_bl_check.py, copied_tools in test_kbdecide.py, hand lists in test_backlog.py, test_backlog_authority.py, test_bl_stall.py, test_kblog.py): git grep each removed module over _tools/test_*.py before landing. A literal deleted path in an open item's touches is a check error (use globs); done refuses a changed file outside touches (widen on the work branch); an item check `selfdoc.py stale` fails on any stale doc (read it, name it in Self-Reviewed). Use focused `-n 1` test runs; land in the background with the longest timeout; no writes in the clone during land or sync; rm -rf is denied; trailer order Co-Authored-By, Self-Reviewed, KB-Work. The Windows/Intune Autopilot product is never touched (kb/public/**, product lists in README.md, plugin.json, kb-lookup skill, .gitattributes csdl lines, _tools/tests_allowlist.txt).
